quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing: general manager Stephen Kuong-Io Tai said Q1 2026 revenue from the four new interconnect products (MRCD/MDB, PCIe Retimer, CKD and CXL MXC) reached RMB 2.69 hundred million, up 93.8% year on year, and that new products will be an important growth engine as they move to scale. Chairman and CEO Yang Chonghe said Q1 2026 overall gross margin was 69.8% and interconnect-chip gross margin 71.5%, up 7.0 points year on year and 3.8 points quarter on quarter, as new-sub-generation RCDs and new products took a larger share, and expects interconnect margins to stay high through sub-generation upgrades and new products.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 new-product revenue RMB 2.69 hundred million (+93.8%); gross margin 69.8%; interconnect gross margin 71.5%

quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roadmap (results briefing): general manager Stephen Kuong-Io Tai said the company plans to complete engineering development this year of the sixth-sub-generation DDR5 RCD (up to 9200MT/s, 15% above the fifth sub-generation's 8000MT/s) and the third-generation MRCD/MDB (up to 16000MT/s, 25% above the second generation's 12800MT/s); its third-sub-generation RCD revenue exceeded the second sub-generation's in H2 2025. Chairman Yang Chonghe said the PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x Retimer sampled in January 2025 is in customer testing with scale use expected in 2027 as PCIe 6.0 CPUs ramp; it has developed 32GT/s and 64GT/s SerDes IP in-house, is developing 128GT/s SerDes for PCIe 7.0 and has started Ethernet SerDes IP; it plans to start first-generation DDR6 memory-interconnect chip development this year.
